lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਪੈਧਾ ਜਾਇ ਦਰਗਹ ਭਾਣੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: hukamee paidhaa jaai daragah bhaaneeai ||
lines.translation: If it pleases the Commander, one goes to His Court, robed in honor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਹੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਮਾਰ ਬੰਦਿ ਰਬਾਣੀਐ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: hukame hee sir maar ba(n)d rabaaneeai ||5||
lines.translation: By His Command, God's slaves are hit over the head. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਾਹਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਆਉ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: laahaa sach niaau man vasaaeeai ||
lines.translation: The profit is earned by enshrining Truth and justice in the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ਗਰਬੁ ਵਞਾਈਐ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: likhiaa palai paai garab vanjaaeeai ||6||
lines.translation: They obtain what is written in their destiny, and overcome pride. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੀਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਮਾਰ ਵਾਦਿ ਖਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukheeaa sir maar vaad khapaaeeai ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are hit over the head, and consumed by conflict.

lines.gurmukhi: ਠਗਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਬੰਨੑਿ ਚਲਾਈਐ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: thag muthee kooRiaar ba(n)nhi chalaaeeai ||7||
lines.translation: The cheaters are plundered by falsehood; they are chained and led away. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਾਇ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਵਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: saahib ridai vasaai na pachhotaavahee ||
lines.translation: Enshrine the Lord Master in your mind, and you shall not have to repent.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਨਹਾਂ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਵਹੀ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: gunahaa(n) bakhasanahaar sabad kamaavahee ||8||
lines.translation: He forgives our sins, when we practice the Teachings of the Guru's Word. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਸਚੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਘਾਲੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak ma(n)gai sach guramukh ghaaleeai ||
lines.translation: Nanak begs for the True Name, which is obtained by the Gurmukh.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੀਐ ॥੯॥੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: mai tujh bin avar na koi nadar nihaaleeai ||9||16||
lines.translation: Without You, I have no other at all; please, bless me with Your Glance of Grace. ||9||16||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਜੰਗਲੁ ਢੂਢੀ ਜਾਇ ਮੈ ਘਰਿ ਬਨੁ ਹਰੀਆਵਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiaa ja(n)gal dhoodhee jaai mai ghar ban hareeaavalaa ||
lines.translation: Why should I go searching in the forests, when the woods of my home are so green?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਟਿਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇ ਸਬਦਿ ਉਤਾਵਲਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sach tikai ghar aai sabad utaavalaa ||1||
lines.translation: The True Word of the Shabad has instantaneously come and settled in my heart. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਸੋਇ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jah dekhaa tah soi avar na jaaneeai ||
lines.translation: Wherever I look, there He is; I know no other.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kee kaar kamaai mahal pachhaaneeai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Working for the Guru, one realizes the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਸਚੁ ਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap milaavai sach taa man bhaavaee ||
lines.translation: The True Lord blends us with Himself, when it is pleasing to His Mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਲੈ ਸਦਾ ਰਜਾਇ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਵਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: chalai sadaa rajaai a(n)k samaavaee ||2||
lines.translation: One who ever walks in accordance with His Will, merges into His Being. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa saahib man vasai vasiaa man soee ||
lines.translation: When the True Lord dwells in the mind, that mind flourishes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਦੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: aape de vadiaaeeaa de tot na hoee ||3||
lines.translation: He Himself grants greatness; His Gifts are never exhausted. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਬੇ ਤਬੇ ਕੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਕਿਉ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: abe tabe kee chaakaree kiu daragah paavai ||
lines.translation: Serving this and that person, how can one obtain the Lord's Court?

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਥਰ ਕੀ ਬੇੜੀ ਜੇ ਚੜੈ ਭਰ ਨਾਲਿ ਬੁਡਾਵੈ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: pathar kee beRee je chaRai bhar naal budaavai ||4||
lines.translation: If someone embarks on a boat of stone, he shall drown with its cargo. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਨੜਾ ਮਨੁ ਵੇਚੀਐ ਸਿਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapanaRaa man vecheeai sir deejai naale ||
lines.translation: So offer your mind, and surrender your head with it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਅਪਨਾ ਘਰੁ ਭਾਲੇ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh vasat pachhaaneeai apanaa ghar bhaale ||5||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh realizes the true essence, and finds the home of his own self. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੰਮਣ ਮਰਣਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਤਿਨਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਕੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ja(n)man maranaa aakheeai tin karatai keeaa ||
lines.translation: People discuss birth and death; the Creator created this.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਮਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਥੀਆ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: aap gavaaiaa mar rahe phir maran na theeaa ||6||
lines.translation: Those who conquer their selfhood and remain dead, shall never have to die again. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਈ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਧੁਰ ਕੀ ਫੁਰਮਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: saaee kaar kamaavanee dhur kee phuramaaee ||
lines.translation: Do those deeds which the Primal Lord has ordered for you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਕਿਨਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: je man satigur de milai kin keemat paaee ||7||
lines.translation: If one surrenders his mind upon meeting the True Guru, who can estimate its value? ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਤਨਾ ਪਾਰਖੁ ਸੋ ਧਣੀ ਤਿਨਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ratanaa paarakh so dhanee tin keemat paaee ||
lines.translation: That Lord Master is the Assayer of the jewel of the mind; He places the value on it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੮॥੧੭॥
lines.transliteration: naanak saahib man vasai sachee vadiaaee ||8||17||
lines.translation: O Nanak, True is the Glory of that one, in whose mind the Lord Master dwells. ||8||17||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinhee naam visaariaa doojai bharam bhulaaee ||
lines.translation: Those who have forgotten the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are deluded by doubt and duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੂਲੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਡਾਲੀ ਲਗੇ ਕਿਆ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਛਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: mool chhod daalee lage kiaa paavahi chhaaee ||1||
lines.translation: Those who abandon the roots and cling to the branches, shall obtain only ashes. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਉ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਜੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin naavai kiu chhooteeai je jaanai koee ||
lines.translation: Without the Name, how can one be emancipated? Who knows this?

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh hoi ta chhooteeai manamukh pat khoee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: One who becomes Gurmukh is emancipated; the self-willed manmukhs lose their honor. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਏਕੋ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinhee eko seviaa pooree mat bhaaee ||
lines.translation: Those who serve the One Lord become perfect in their understanding, O Siblings of Destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਾ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: aad jugaad nira(n)janaa jan har saranaaee ||2||
lines.translation: The Lord's humble servant finds Sanctuary in Him, the Immaculate One, from the very beginning, and throughout the ages. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: saahib meraa ek hai avar nahee bhaaee ||
lines.translation: My Lord and Master is the One; there is no other, O Siblings of Destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਚੇ ਪਰਥਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: kirapaa te sukh paaiaa saache parathaaee ||3||
lines.translation: By the Grace of the True Lord, celestial peace is obtained. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਕੇਤੀ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur bin kinai na paaio ketee kahai kahaae ||
lines.translation: Without the Guru, no one has obtained Him, although many may claim to have done so.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਵਾਟੜੀਂ ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: aap dikhaavai vaataRee(n) sachee bhagat driRaae ||4||
lines.translation: He Himself reveals the Way, and implants true devotion within. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਜੇ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਭੀ ਉਝੜਿ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh je samajhaaeeai bhee ujhaR jaae ||
lines.translation: Even if the self-willed manmukh is instructed, he stills goes into the wilderness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨ ਛੂਟਸੀ ਮਰਿ ਨਰਕ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: bin har naam na chhootasee mar narak samaae ||5||
lines.translation: Without the Lord's Name, he shall not be emancipated; he shall die, and sink into hell. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਭਰਮਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਲੇਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam marai bharamaaeeai har naam na levai ||
lines.translation: He wanders through birth and death, and never chants the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵੈ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: taa kee keemat naa pavai bin gur kee sevai ||6||
lines.translation: He never realizes his own value, without serving the Guru. ||6||
